programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: Builder Chase Morrill, along with Ashley Morrill-Eldridge and Ryan Eldridge, his sister and brother-in-law, transform cabins in some of the most beautiful areas of Maine. From historic cottages to camp cabins, scenic retreats get the facelifts they need.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: The team takes on a project to restore a lakeside cabin once shared by a homeowner and her late husband, who died shortly after they bought it. She hopes for major updates, like a new roof, fresh stain, an expanded living room, and a quiet lookout.

programs.title: Motel Rescue
programs.desc: In the Louisiana bayou, a second-generation motel owner is struggling mightily; having never learned the ropes from his father before inheriting it, this owner and his motel are desperate; it's one of Lindsey's biggest projects of all time.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.desc: Mark challenges the two youngest members of the team to take down a few logs; Johnny gets a special visit from his dad; Graham reveals some secrets about the pioneers; the guys take a tour of an old grist mill; Johnny Jett's favorite covered bridge.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.desc: The guys salvage five tobacco barns on one farm in Alton, Virginia, while Mark hunts for even more barns in Pennsylvania; Mark also visits an incredible finished home made of two cabins combined with a salt box addition.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.desc: The Barnwood Builders travel to Eagle Rock, Va., to build a dogtrot cabin in the Blue Ridge Mountains; Tim Rose travels to Halifax, Va., to see the finished log cabin they built five years earlier at the Springfield Distillery.
